name: 2D Transfer Function Volume Rendering
aliases: TF based on value and gradient magnitude
definition: A volume rendering technique that uses a 2D histogram of intensity vs. gradient magnitude to define color and opacity, providing superior tissue differentiation compared to traditional 1D transfer functions which only use intensity.
summary: 2D Transfer Function Volume Rendering maps scalar values and gradient magnitude to color and opacity, uniquely isolating material boundaries and homogeneous regions to solve overlapping data-value intervals.
